teaser: I read the newsroom on four devices and they do not agree. Missing a feature is the best sign; the makers must use it. And the brief for the reader's vault.
core_idea: The people who decide a roadmap have to use the product: they give the best feedback and direction, and when they do not use it, something is missing. Dinis failed that test with earlier startups and the vaults now pass it, getting better because they are used. With agents able to build almost anything, direction from usage is the scarce part, and the speed of the loop from comment to article to feature is the moat. Reading the newsroom on four devices that do not agree is the signal for the next feature: the reader's own encrypted vault, with an access key, a key pair, a log per device merged by union, a way to add a device, and a one-way line to the agent that edits the site.
